title: Character side panel
changes: Character, Inventory and Skills now open in one panel on the right side, with tabs (C, G, T or click a tab).
A stats block (health, mana, defense, attack, damage, magic, spell damage, crit) stays on top and updates live. Hover an item, a skill or a stat point to see what it would change in green or red.
Bag tools: sort your bag, mark items that raise no stat, and drop them all at once.
Loot filter: choose to pick up only Magic, Rare or Legendary gear, or only gear your class can wear. Skipped drops look faded on the ground.
